name: Multilabel Emotion Classification
description: Developed and evaluated five deep learning approaches for multilabel emotion classification on Twitter data across 11 emotion categories. Fine-tuned ModernBERT and Gemma-2-2B using LoRA and 4-bit quantization, and deployed models for inference using vLLM with constrained decoding.

name: Credit Risk Prediction Model
description: Built a credit risk prediction framework on the American Express dataset (5.5M rows, 190 features) achieving XGBoost AUC ~0.95. Engineered behavioral features, reduced dimensionality to 17 predictors via SHAP analysis, and designed conservative vs. aggressive approval strategies.

name: Conagra Brands – Sales Forecasting
description: Analyzed 50k+ retail transactions using clustering and LASSO regression to identify key sales drivers and three distinct consumer segments. Buyer persona profiling across demographics. Recognized as a Top 3 presentation out of 20 teams. Sponsored by Conagra Brands.

name: Image Classification with CNNs (CIFAR-10)
description: Designed and trained convolutional neural networks on the CIFAR-10 dataset for 10-class image classification. Explored architecture choices including batch normalization, dropout, and data augmentation to improve generalization and accuracy.

name: Deep Learning – Final Project
description: Final deep learning course project applying advanced neural network architectures and training techniques to a real-world problem.
